lines.text: In Eden, Nayuta sits cross-legged on the railing, surveying the battlefield.
The Raptures are pressing in on Eden from all directions.
Their movements are unnervingly unified—perfectly in sync.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So it is. The Queen's sway could not have reached the Heretics alone.
The Pioneer and Inherit squads are fighting brilliantly.
No, they're far better than anyone could have imagined.
Though only five in number, they are holding back the massive horde of Raptures.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet...
Tyrant-class Raptures haven't joined yet,
and neither have the Heretics.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Is it but a matter of time ere they be overrun?
Nayuta looks toward the horizon.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I beseech you, do not be late.
Two hours later.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Eden's Spear is ready to fire.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Good. Get it ready.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We'll have to aim and fire manually since the bombardment damaged the remote system.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'll send you the coordinates

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: for the Queen

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: and the Heretics encamped in front of Eden.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You'll need to make a choice.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hup!
Scarlet's blade slashes through a Harvester's leg.
As it staggers, Isabel drives a feather into its head.
The massive creature collapses, sending up dust that blankets the area.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: You actually cut through a Harvester's leg with that sword?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Well, fortune smiles upon me, it seems.
*Thuk!*
A golden blade pierces Scarlet's abdomen.
As the smoke clears, Indivilia emerges from within.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: To think you can use a Tyrant-class Rapture as bait. These mass assaults really are too convenient.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A sneak attack...! Just the sort of trick I might expect of thee...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What, were you hoping for a one-on-one duel? Heh, dream on.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Indivilia!
Isabel dives toward Indivilia.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I'm afraid I have no interest in a direct duel with any of you.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I do hope you survive this endless sea of Raptures,

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: and me as well.
Indivilia slips into the cloud of dust.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: The situation is grim. Indivilia has joined the fray,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: and even Tyrant-class Raptures are pouring in. We're also losing ground from a lack of firepower.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Snow White, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Advance.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What nonsense are you spouting?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We need to move in closer and take out more of them.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: How convenient.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Sorry to be a buzzkill, but we're running low on supplies.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Then I'll take down two per shot.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Heh, you say such crazy things as if it's nothing.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Fine, I'll humor you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'm going. Follow me, Papillon.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Eh? I'm going too? Come on, cut me some slack!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We can't win without supplies.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Just so you know, I'm staying in the safe zone. I'll only dip one toe into this crazy plan of yours.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I don't know how long that safe zone will last, though.
Johan stands before Eden's Spear's aiming controls, lost in thought.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Brother Johan.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What are you hesitating about?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I'm deciding where to fire Eden's Spear.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The front line's crumbling.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The Queen is right above us.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: And we only have one shot.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What is there to hesitate about?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Even if we fail, there will surely be someone to carry on.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Believer {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Right, if it's that guy...

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Isabel is critically damaged and retreating with Scarlet.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: The defensive line has been breached. Snow White and Harran are repositioning. Papillon as well.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: How about the Monk?

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Currently meditating on the railing.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Must be nice.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Multiple heat signatures approaching.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Approximately... 2,000 in number.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... So this is it?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I'll use Eden's Spear on the Queen.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Of the approaching heat signatures, one is moving at high speed.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: It is heading for Indivilia's position.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: Now within identification range.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_l
lines.text: ... What's that supposed to be?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Just in time, more reinforcements arrive.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Hoho, the Queen truly knows nothing of mercy, does she?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Of course, I, too, am rather fond of sweeping my foes aside with sheer numbers.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Nihilister, why don't you at least say something?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You're powerless and silent. At this rate, a scarecrow would've served better.

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: Would you just shut up already, huh?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Heh, I'm afraid I must decline.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: ... Indivilia.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Yes, what is it?

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Whatever's coming doesn't look like Raptures.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... What?
Indivilia turns around
and sees a thick cloud of dust. It's clearly a massive army,
yet she senses nothing.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... Then what could possibly be here in such numbers...?
Something shoots out from the cloud of dust.
Indivilia furrows her brow, trying to make out what it is.
She soon realizes it's something she's seen before,
but by the time it dawns on her, it's already too late.
*Boooom!*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Argh!
Mounted on Trombe, Crown's lance pierces straight through Indivilia.
Indivilia rolls across the ground, struggling to get back up.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Pleasure to see you again.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: How many times... must this farce... be repeated...!?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I genuinely thought you'd manage to dodge that this time. Has your stamina been a bit lacking today?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: The word be "focus," Your Highness!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Ah, yes... quite so, hehe.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: You wretches!
Chatterbox charges at Crown.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S.! Body slam!

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Talo talo!
*Wham!*
T.A.L.O.S. slams into Chatterbox's abdomen,
sending him tumbling backward and putting some distance between them.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: ... Human imposters of the kingdom...!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: ... T.A.L.O.S., what's this "Talo talo"?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: I learned it from a game you like.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: The body slam knocked the target back, but inflicted only minor damage. Special entity Chatterbox remains strong.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Calculating...

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Had the golden arm been properly equipped, significant damage would have been dealt.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: Oh, come on! How many times do you have to go on about that golden arm?!

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: But you promised to replace it with a golden arm.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: I'm working as hard as I can to get to it, so can we stop already?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: So you've come to die?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Far from it.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: You think the likes of you can turn the tide of this battle? Think again.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: That's totally wrong, right, T.A.L.O.S.?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Calculating...

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: The outcome depends on the target's combat capabilities, but purely in terms of numbers, our chances of victory are significantly higher.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What did you say? Have you lost your mi—
The cloud of dust behind them begins to settle.
Countless Nayutas now come into view,
packed so tightly they stretch across the entire horizon.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I have arrived at last.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... What is this?

lines.speaker: nihilister_m
lines.text: ... How the hell... are there this many...?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: 2,000 Nayuta clones...

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Calculating...

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Against several thousand Raptures.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Don't just estimate.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Odds of victory are satisfactory.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Very well! Let us be off then!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Let us proceed.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Damn... these human imposters...!
Black light bursts out from Indivilia's body.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Transformation detected.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: A mere trifle! Fear not,

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: numbers shall ever triumph!
